newsitem.title: EU: EC Report Weekly Diary for Monday, July 7-Sunday, July 13.
newsitem.headline: EC Report Weekly Diary for Monday, July 7-Sunday, July 13.

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS
BRUSSELS - EU finance ministers meet to discuss Italy's economic convergence plan for participating in the single currency (Mon).
BONN - German government and European Commission sponsor ministerial conference on "Global Information Networks: Realising the Potential" (Mon-Tues).
MADRID - NATO holds summit to chart course for enlargement and invite a number of former communist foes to begin membership talks (Tues-Wed).
BRUSSELS - European Commission regular weekly meeting (Wed).
BRUSSELS - EU Economic and Social Committee (ECOSOC) holds plenary session (Wed-Thurs).
BRUSSELS - Signature of agreements between the EU and Israel on procurement by government agencies and telecommunications operators (Thurs).
MONDAY, JULY 7

BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - EU finance ministers meet (0930/0730 GMT). Agenda includes work programme for Luxembourg EU presidency (0930/0730 GMT), Italy's economic convergence plan for participating in the single currency (1100/0900 GMT), follow-up to the Amsterdam EU summit (after lunch). Ministers meet with their counterparts from Central and Eastern Europe for regular "structured dialogue" (1230/1030 GMT).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Luxembourg Justice Minister Marc Fischbach addresses European Parliament Civil Liberties and Legal Affairs Committees on Luxembourg EU presidency (1510/1310 GMT).

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Fischler addresses European Parliament Regional Affairs Committee on the Common Agricultural Policy and rural development policy in the context of the EU's "cohesion" money for its poorer states (1715/1515 GMT).

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Federation of Pharmaceutical Industries Associations holds background briefing on "The debate on owning life - Biotechnology patents briefing" (1030/0830 GMT). Venue: Bruxelles-Europe Liaison Bureau, 63 avenue d'Auderghem. Contact: European Federation of Pharmaceutical Industries Associations (322) 626 2555

BONN (EXPANDED ITEM) - German government and European Commission sponsor ministerial conference on "Global Information Networks: Realising the Potential" (and Tues). European Commissioners Bangemann and Monti attend. Draft agenda includes:
- (0900/0700 GMT) German Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt, European Commissioner Bangemann and Luxembourg Communications Minister Mady Delvaux-Stehers give opening remarks.
- (0930/0730 GMT) First plenary session "Building confidence".
- (1130/0930 GMT) Second plenary session "Empowering the user".
- (1430/1230 GMT) Third plenary session "Making the most of content resources".

LUXEMBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Commission and Association of Public Health Schools in the European Region (ASPHER) sponsor Summer School on Health Promotion and Public Health in the European Union. Venue: Jean Monnet Building. Contact: European Commission (352) 4301 32059.
TUESDAY, JULY 8
BONN - Global Information Networks ministerial conference (second of two days).
Agenda includes:
- (1230/1030 GMT) German Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt and European Commissioner Bangemann give closing remarks.

MADRID - NATO holds summit to chart course for enlargement and invite a number of former communist foes to begin membership talks (and Wed). (possibly) In margins of the summit, EU Luxembourg presidency, European Commission and U.S. meet to discuss transatlantic issues.
WEDNESDAY, JULY 9
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission regular weekly meeting (0900/0700 GMT).
Provisional agenda includes:
- Proposal for legislation on the legal protection of "conditional access" systems for pay media services
- Proposal for a recommendation on electronic payments in the single market.
- Proposal for legislation on end-of-life vehicles.
- 1997 demographic report.
- Financial assistance to projects submitted by EU states on protection of forests against atmospheric pollution and fires.
BRUSSELS - European Commission and South Africa meet at ministerial level to pursue technical discussions on future bilateral agreement.

BRUSSELS - EU Economic and Social Committee (ECOSOC) holds plenary session (and Thurs). Agenda includes: combating tobacco consumption; eco-label award scheme; transport of dangerous goods; transportable pressure equipment; benchmarking; global information society; vertical restraints; equal opportunities for women and men in the EU; conservation of fishery resources in the waters of the Baltic Sea; relations between EU and African, Caribbean and Pacific countries; common VAT system; taxation in the EU.
BRUSSELS - European Newspaper Publishers' Association (ENPA) holds round table on "Media ethics and politics" (1000/0800 GMT). Venue: Hotel Le Dome. Contact: ENPA (322) 551 0190.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime meeting on "Reporting the EU" (1315/1115 GMT). Speaker is: The Guardian European Editor John Palmer. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.
THURSDAY, JULY 10
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Signature of agreements between the EU and Israel on procurement by government agencies and by telecommunicaitons operators (1245/1045 GMT). Venue: Justus Lipsius building.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Research Committee on European Unification holds seminar on "Amsterdam and beyond: the EU facing the challenges of the 21st century" (0900/0700 GMT) (to Saturday).

BRUSSELS - European Newspaper Publishers' Association (ENPA) holds conference on "Media and the challenge of intolerance - setting standards for change" (1000/0800 GMT) (and Sat). Venue: Hotel Le Dome. Contact: ENPA (322) 551 0190.

EDINBURGH - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds conference on "Network industries in Europe: preparing for competition" (To July 11). Speakers include: European Commissioner Neil Kinnock. Venue: Balmoral Hotel. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.
FRIDAY, JULY 11

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Research Committee on European Unification holds seminar on "Amsterdam and beyond: the EU facing the challenges of the 21st century" (0900/0700 GMT) (second of three days). European Commissioner Santer gives address at 1730/1530 GMT.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - (possibly) European Commission and United States hold consultations on the EU-U.S. civil aircraft subsidies agreement.
SATURDAY, JULY 12
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Research Committee on European Unification holds seminar on "Amsterdam and beyond: the EU facing the challenges of the 21st century" (0900/0700 GMT) (last of three days).
SUNDAY, JULY 13
No events scheduled.
